tools.name: tps_tv_read_sharepoint
tools.description: Return the SharePoint sites and content associated with the signed-in user. Defaults to the signed-in user: "the signed-in user".

displayName.description: Display name to look up. Defaults to "the signed-in user".

tools.name: tps_tv_add_to_sharepoint
tools.description: Upload an asset (file or link), with its supporting request/project/account record, to SharePoint via Power Automate.

assetType.description: Asset type, e.g. "Scoping Doc", "Company Logo", "Other Link".

displayName.description: User-supplied display name — only present for asset types without a fixed label.

displayFileName.description: Display name shown for this asset: displayName if supplied, otherwise assetType.

summary.description: Summary text describing the asset contents. Omitted for asset types that don't show a Summary field.

linkUrl.description: URL for link-based assets (assetType "Other Link"). Omit for file-based assets.

fileName.description: Uploaded file's name, e.g. "document.pdf". Omit for link-based assets.

fileExtension.description: Uploaded file's extension including the dot, e.g. ".pdf". Omit for link-based assets.

fileType.description: Uploaded file's MIME type, e.g. "application/pdf". Omit for link-based assets.

fileContent.description: Base64-encoded file content. Omit for link-based assets.

request.description: Deal Registration / request record associated with this document.

project.description: Project record associated with this document.

account.description: Account record associated with this document.

sharepoint.description: Existing SharePoint assets for this request. Defaults to { countassets: 0, assets: [] } when the request has none yet.

tools.name: tps_tv_read_direct_reports
tools.description: Return the team members associated with the signed-in user: "the signed-in user". Conversational by default (plain data, no widget). Only set _meta: { useWidget: true } on the call when the user wants an interactive widget instead.

displayName.description: Testing only, requires server-side identity testing permission: overrides the signed-in user's display name for this call.

email.description: Testing only, requires server-side identity testing permission: overrides the signed-in user's email for this call.

tools.name: tps_tv_read_tpsc_user_summary
tools.description: Return TPSC data (Deal Registrations) for the signed-in user or one of their direct reports. Do not ask the user for their name, email, or job title — never required. For "my own" requests, call this with no arguments at all; it already knows the caller is "the signed-in user" <(resolved securely on first use)>. Only pass displayName/email when the request is explicitly about a different person (one of the signed-in user's direct reports) — that's validated against the team roster. jobTitle is never required. This tool never shows a widget, under any circumstances. To display the result (optionally after enriching it with data from another source), call tps_tv_read_tpsc_user_summary_widget with the final { projects, requests } data.

displayName.description: Only set this when asking about someone else (a direct report). Omit for "my own" requests — defaults to "the signed-in user".

email.description: Only set this when asking about someone else (a direct report). Omit for "my own" requests — defaults to "(resolved securely on first use)".

jobTitle.description: Optional, rarely needed — do not ask the user for this.

tools.name: tps_tv_read_tpsc_user_summary_widget
tools.description: Display TPSC summary data in the interactive widget. Always shows the widget — this is the ONLY tool that does for TPSC summaries. Never fetches anything itself; call tps_tv_read_tpsc_user_summary first to get the data (optionally enrich it with data from another source), then call this tool with the result to display it.

data.description: The { projects, requests } payload to display — the (optionally enriched) result of a prior tps_tv_read_tpsc_user_summary call.

tools.name: tps_tv_read_tpsc_request_detail
tools.description: Return TPSC detail for a specific request, project, and account. This tool never shows a widget, under any circumstances. To display the result (optionally after enriching it with data from another source), call tps_tv_read_tpsc_request_detail_widget with the final data.

tools.name: tps_tv_read_tpsc_request_detail_widget
tools.description: Display TPSC request detail in the interactive widget. Always shows the widget — this is the ONLY tool that does for request detail. Never fetches anything itself; call tps_tv_read_tpsc_request_detail first to get the data (optionally enrich it with data from another source), then call this tool with the result to display it.

data.description: The { requests, projects, accounts } payload to display — the (optionally enriched) result of a prior tps_tv_read_tpsc_request_detail call.

tools.name: tps_tv_read_tpsc_opp_detail
tools.description: Return TPSC detail for a specific project and account. This tool never shows a widget, under any circumstances. To display the result (optionally after enriching it with data from another source), call tps_tv_read_tpsc_opp_detail_widget with the final data.

tools.name: tps_tv_read_tpsc_opp_detail_widget
tools.description: Display TPSC project/opportunity detail in the interactive widget. Always shows the widget — this is the ONLY tool that does for opportunity detail. Never fetches anything itself; call tps_tv_read_tpsc_opp_detail first to get the data (optionally enrich it with data from another source), then call this tool with the result to display it.

data.description: The { projects, accounts } payload to display — the (optionally enriched) result of a prior tps_tv_read_tpsc_opp_detail call. Each project entry carries its own nested requests[] array.

tools.name: tps_tv_summarize_document
tools.description: Generate a short summary of the given text via Azure OpenAI. Internal fallback for the tps_tv_add_to_sharepoint widget's "New summary" button — not intended for direct model use.

text.description: Prompt or extracted document text to summarize.

tools.name: tps_tv_take_it_with_you
tools.description: Publishes the given standalone-snapshot HTML and returns a QR code PNG url encoding a link to it. Internal to the TPSC widgets' "take it with you" button -- not intended for direct model use.

content.description: The standalone snapshot HTML to publish.
